correctness.rationale: Direct source-equation transcription verified on PDF p.12; food-mass conservation and human/bacteria equilibrium balances give a scalar infected-pressure consistency equation. The unique positive contaminated-food root has positive derivative and strictly negative second derivative for every B>0, so C(kI)/I strictly decreases, while the human-balance side strictly increases to infinity. Endpoint limits at Delta positive, zero, and negative prove exactly the three asserted regimes. A Metzler Jacobian and strictly signed positive test vectors classify strict local stability/instability on fixed-F leaves. The rational old-subcritical positive equilibrium is directly substituted into all five equations with exact arithmetic in verify.py; symbolic identities and Jacobian match; VERIFY_OK. Equality of the new threshold is only nonhyperbolic, and no global or positive-equilibrium stability is claimed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2002 general next-generation theorem can imply a local Jacobian threshold after constructing correct infected compartments, but it does not provide the precise F-dependent correction or global positive-equilibrium uniqueness for this nonlinear model. The 2020 and 2021 food-contamination papers derive their own thresholds in different worker/food-resupply/logistic-bacterial systems; the 2026 Omar et al. article uses an externally replenished-food and logistic-reservoir model. None dominates the specific conserved-food feedback theorem.

originality.rationale: A precisely scoped all-parameter positive-equilibrium classification of the printed Koutou–Kouanda–Ouédraogo (2026) listeriosis-only model is not implied by its Proposition 4.2: that proposition asserts the strictly smaller paper Rhat as the criterion, contradicted by the exact positive witness at Rhat=2/3. The older food-threshold literature and general next-generation theory were materially compared and are acknowledged rather than claimed as new. Those sources employ different food-mass, human-to-bacteria, worker, bacterial-growth or risk-class assumptions and do not give the specific conserved-F leafwise nonlinear uniqueness criterion. Published published-finding corpus searches showed no equivalent or stronger claim. Undiscovered coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed or subsequently published mathematical analyses could independently derive the same corrected criterion.
The original five-equation model is physically idealized, and positive F is determined by an invariant initial mass rather than a measured epidemiological distribution.
No claim is made about the unsplit original eight-compartment model or full global dynamics.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a mathematically necessary-and-sufficient invasion/endemic-existence partition for a published listeriosis model over every positive parameter choice and positive conserved food stock, correcting an erroneous threshold-based if-and-only-if proposition. It establishes an exact rational counterexample with the published value below unity, a structural infinite-dimensional-parameter family criterion, and distinct autocontamination-dominated regime; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice, superficial normalization check, or generic next-generation theorem relabeling.
